Setup and other ways to open this route

Install the RS Android companion once, plus OsmAnd and the offline map for your trip. In the companion, check the route name and tap Start chosen route in OsmAnd. Use the Driving profile.

For a larger route, open the downloaded .rsnav file with RS → OsmAnd, then tap Start.

OsmAnd provides its own guidance. Road matching, the approach from your location, and later rerouting can change the path. RS exclusion zones do not transfer. Check the route before driving.

Phone links require your existing RS sign-in and expire after 24 hours. If signing in loses this route link, scan the desktop QR code again.
